depth.primary: 0 4px 0 pressed-blue, collapsing to 0 1px 0 + translateY(3px) on press
depth.tile: soft two-layer standing shadow (--depth-tile) on interactive post-mode rows/tiles
depth.arcade: Home mode-card exception only: 2px solid text-colour border + 2px 2px 0 hard offset shadow, collapsing via diagonal translate(2px, 2px) on press

principles: Geography is the content; interface is the instrument
Atlas is mobile-first, low-friction, information-first and minimally gamified
Atlas Blue drives ordinary action while green and red stay correctness feedback
Region-by-domain Mastery is purple; gold is deliberately scarce completion/prestige
Country records are live learning evidence, not learner-facing prestige objects
Ordinary progress is a quiet blue successful-retrieval strip rather than a mastery dashboard
The dedicated Progress screen is retired; progress is surfaced in Home, domain indexes, launchers and Results
A single Perfect round is transient result feedback and is not persistent Mastery
Complete regions use restrained gold without a separate badge or Crown
Completed continent rows render the shipped continent trophy/crest artwork on domain continent indexes
World completion alone reserves the Crown; an earned-only World Crown state is surfaced quietly on Home
Mobile-first interaction and no horizontal scrolling for primary selection
Radius, depth, typography, navigation composition and milestone scarcity remain locked as Tactile Atlas
Navigation is mode-first: Home chooses the learning domain, the domain index chooses a supported continent, and launcher rows start Play directly for continent or region scope
Learn remains a subordinate whole-continent action on launchers; Flags Learn is a browse-and-reveal gallery
No continent, region or hemisphere colour taxonomy; colour always reinforces another state cue
No glassmorphism, bento dashboards or decorative UI overload
